The same thing applies to [metaPool](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/pull/804/files#diff-7fcb277a6e130377e1cfe7127e1a021b81dd6b445342cf89f426b636b28fae1aR116) which should be smth like `curveMetaPoolDollarTriPoolLp` (so that it was obvious from the 1st glance what is this contract about) 2. There should not be any errors on start. Either hardcode sushi swap pool and curve metapool addresses on the frontend either update the deployment script. The purpose of this issue is to make staking back to work. We'll refactor hardcoded values later. 3. Even when I hardcoded all of the addresses (sushi swap pool , curve meta poll) I got the following error for the address which doesn't have any staked tokens (pls fix):

I've hardcoded the following addresses across the code: 1. [sushiPoolGovernanceDollarLp](https://etherscan.io/address/0x41e087485f47538752A1195D984109cB8Dc0E429) 2. I'm asking to fix the staking page so that there were no any errors on start. One of the ways is to hardcode contract addresses which are missing in the deploy script (`sushiPoolGovernanceDollarLp, curveMetaPoolDollarTriPoolLp, _3crvTokenContract`) on the frontend.

Approving this one because the original issue spec is implemented.
Credits page [error](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/pull/809#issuecomment-1752572290) will be solved as a part of this [issue](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/issues/786).

2. Pls fix all of the pavlovcik's comments
3. Regarding this [error](https://github.com/ubiquity/ubiquity-dollar/pull/809#issuecomment-1752572290). You said that you can't solve it so we asked @molecula451 to help with it. So we're waiting for some more info on that issue. We can't merge a PR with runtime errors.
